execution_provenance.boundary: The executed commit contained the frozen, locally verified Gate-B code and config. The later authorization commit changed only registry, TODO, README, and status-test expectations.

artifact_integrity.windows_text_hash_boundary: stdout.log and resource_usage.txt are CRLF in the Windows worktree; their committed LF blobs exactly match the Linux ledger. This is checkout normalization, not post-run mutation.

execution_contract.environment_advisory: environment.txt was generated with another interpreter (Python 3.13.9), whereas the timed runner manifest records Python 3.11.15 and NumPy 2.3.5. The run manifest and /usr/bin/time command identify the actual runner, but the auxiliary environment file is not a complete execution-environment record.

analysis_support.generality_boundary: All 24 days come from one consecutive validation interval on one unit; they are not independent plant replications.

frozen_primary_gate.label: PASS
frozen_primary_gate.multiplicity: Two prespecified action-side contrasts within each specificity/timing family use simultaneous 97.5% bootstrap intervals for familywise alpha 0.05.
frozen_primary_gate.boundary: This is a median UTC-day gate. A had two negative days in both families, so PASS does not mean every date was invariant.

serial_day_sensitivity.boundary: This audit sensitivity was not part of the frozen primary gate and does not create new confirmatory claims.

short_horizon_mimo.label: CONDITIONAL_LOCAL_MIMO_SUPPORTED
short_horizon_mimo.boundary: Rows are residualized A/B valve innovations and columns are A/B local Tin-minus-Tout changes. These are closed-loop conditional coefficients, not open-loop spray-flow gains.

invariance_diagnostics.boundary: Every stratum is data-derived and contains only 6-8 UTC days; no paired interval was frozen for differences between strata or directions.

placebo_and_downstream.label: UPSTREAM_PLACEBO_NONZERO_AND_TERMINAL_SIDE_SPECIFICITY_FAIL
placebo_and_downstream.long_horizon_local_boundary: At H600 the A local future diagonal is approximately zero while its lead diagonal is 0.19984; H300/H600 remain diagnostic-only.
placebo_and_downstream.interpretation: The short local path is stronger and better timed than these placebos, but unmeasured closed-loop disturbance remains. Terminal side-specific hard constraints are not supported.

iv_assessment.label: SP_IV_NOT_SUPPORTED_AS_CAUSAL_ROUTE
iv_assessment.boundary: Nonzero first-stage medians do not establish a strong or exogenous instrument. Weak partial R2, co-action, and wrong-side response prevent an IV causal upgrade.

supervisor_decision.label: GATE_B_FROZEN_PRIMARY_PASS
supervisor_decision.claim_boundary: Gate B supports a disturbance-conditioned, measured-boundary short-horizon conditional MIMO response block. It does not identify an open-loop plant, measured spray-flow physics, arbitrary do(valve), terminal side-specific causality, or a valid SP instrument.
